annotations.title: Compare the U.S. duty on one HTS line across countries of origin

description: Computes the same duty total as duty_stack for one 8- or 10-digit HTS line across up to 30 countries of origin and returns them sorted from the lowest total, each with its base rate, the Chapter 99 headings applied and the number of open questions. Without "origins" it compares 20 large sources of U.S. imports. Each row uses default assumptions (no trade-agreement preference claimed, no special use).

ad_valorem_equivalent_pct.description: Optional ad valorem equivalent, in percent, of a specific or compound column 1 rate.

answers.description: Optional answers applied to every origin, by question id, e.g. {"preference": true}.

hts_code.description: HTS number with 8 or 10 digits, dotted or not, e.g. "9403.60.80".

origins.description: Countries of origin to compare: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes or English names, e.g. ["CN", "VN", "MX"].

name: compare_origins
title: Compare the U.S. duty on one HTS line across countries of origin
